transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thank you. Um... well, I guess I'm just having some issues at work lately. 

I'll sit down to start an EPIC quality report, or I'll be in a clinic metrics meeting, and... I mean to pay attention. I have every intention of tracking what's going on. But within just a few minutes, my mind just sort of... drifts. I'll catch myself rereading the exact same numbers over and over, or I'll realize I completely missed the point of the discussion. 

So... yeah. I thought I should probably come in.
How long have you been having these difficulties with your focus and attention?

Um... it's been a while, I suppose. Since my promotion, mostly. That was about two years and four months ago. The new role just... it came with a much larger portfolio, and I guess the systems I used to rely on just aren't cutting it anymore.
Looking back to your childhood or school years, did you ever struggle with your attention, focus, or organization back then?

Well... yes, I suppose so. 

Um... even back in elementary school, my teachers would write on my report cards that I was... bright, but careless. And my mother... she always had to sit with me while I did my homework. I guess I'd lose track of what I was supposed to be doing, or... I'd just forget to bring my books home from school in the first place. So... yeah, it's been a thing for a while, I guess.
Do you often feel physically restless, like you have difficulty sitting still or feel an inner drive to constantly be on the go?

Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really have trouble sitting still. I'm usually at my desk most of the day for work, and I don't feel like I need to be moving around or anything. So... no, not really.
